start.text: The new defenses are in place. The malware is already moving between computers, and I do not think we will wait long.
start.name: Joshua

A.text: Joshua! It is on the move. It copies itself from laptop to laptop, and it hides while it does.
A.name: Carla

B.text: It is the same program from Ben's laptop. It will try every trick it has.
B.name: Joshua

C.text: That is what makes it dangerous. I counted three tricks already.
C.name: Carla

D1.text: A [b][color=red]trojan[/color][/b] that looks like a gift, a [b][color=red]worm[/color][/b] that copies itself, and [b][color=red]spyware[/color][/b] that hides and watches what you type.
D1.name: Carla

D2.text: That depends on the upgrades you equipped. Each trick has one defense that stops it. Without that defense, the trick comes back [b][color=red]harder[/color][/b].
D2.name: Carla

E.text: Use your cards to weaken the threat and to raise your Block. When it attacks, you dodge. Keep going until it is [b][color=green]contained[/color][/b].
E.name: Carla

F.text: Understood. Let's stop it before it reaches anything else.
F.name: Joshua

G.text: Everything I set up in Hardening is about to be tested.
G.name: Joshua
